CursorPagination.title: CursorPagination
CursorPagination.description:
Pagination metadata for cursor-based list responses.

Attributes:
    next_cursor: Encoded cursor for the next page, or None on the last page.
    prev_cursor: Encoded cursor for the previous page, or None on the first page.
    items_per_page: Number of items requested per page.
    has_more: Whether there is at least one more page after this one.

EditableCustomField.title: EditableCustomField

MyTeamProfileUpdate.title: MyTeamProfileUpdate
MyTeamProfileUpdate.description: Full replacement of the team fields a member may edit.

pages.title: Pages
pages.description: Total number of pages, or ``None`` when ``total_count`` is unknown.

OffsetPagination.title: OffsetPagination
OffsetPagination.description:
Pagination metadata for offset-based list responses.

Attributes:
    total_count: Total number of items across all pages.
        ``None`` when ``include_total=False``.
    items_per_page: Number of items per page
    page: Current page number (1-indexed)
    has_more: Whether there are more pages
    pages: Total number of pages
